ns2:section.sectionText: This graduate-level seminar will cover the latest research in the Internet of Things from a networked systems perspective. We will discuss advances in foundational networking and systems design techniques for the Internet of Things and highlight novel inference approaches to connect the underlying data to its end applications. Students will experience and possibly build applications on top of novel IoT platforms in digital healthcare, data-driven agriculture, ocean sensing, autonomous vehicles, security, satellites, and others.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, or NDEG:Computer Science Onl-UIUC.
